plays.desc_ko: LYON의 바론 시도를 막기 위해 G2가 TP로 합류하고 SkewMond가 진입(Cyclone), Hans Sama도 차이를 만들려 하지만 역부족.
plays.desc_en: G2 teleports in to stop Baron and SkewMond (Wukong) engages with Cyclone while Hans Sama (Yunara) tries to make a difference, but it isn't enough.
plays.quote: is going to TP in. ... they're going to have to try and stop ... Skan ready to move in. Cyclone there.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 바론 체력을 유지한 채 Berserker가 측면에서 Caps를 솔로킬, BrokenBlade에 락다운 적중 후 교전 승리('sending G2 to Valhalla')와 함께 바론 획득. 리플레이: Caps가 쓰러진 뒤 플레이를 걸었고 Dhokla도 생존.
plays.desc_en: Holding Baron's health, Berserker (Caitlyn) solo kills Caps from the flank and BrokenBlade is locked down as LYON wins the fight, 'sending G2 to Valhalla,' and secures Baron, with Dhokla surviving.
plays.quote: BERSERKER SOLO KILLING ... determined to take the objective. ... DOWN ON THE BROKEN BLADE.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 G2 기지를 압박하자 Caps가 로켓 벨트로 빠지고 Hans Sama가 Q 중첩, Isles의 Mel's(Mikael) 소모를 유도. 이어 Caps의 Scatter가 적중했으나 후속이 없어 사거리로 견제하며 웨이브 정리 시도.
plays.desc_en: As LYON pressures G2's base, Caps (Syndra) escapes with Rocket Belt and Hans Sama stacks Q to draw out Isles' Mikael's Blessing; Caps lands Scatter the Weak but without follow-up, G2 pokes from range to clear waves.
plays.quote: Good rocket belt out from Caps ... Male's now going to ... another scatter. This one connecting,

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 BrokenBlade에게 달려들어 집요하게 노림. BrokenBlade는 살아남지만 그 대가로 Lulu 궁극기(Wild Growth로 추정)가 소모됨.
plays.desc_en: Dhokla (Olaf) relentlessly dives BrokenBlade (Jayce), who survives at the cost of Labrov's Wild Growth.
plays.quote: running in for broken blade. ... Hold on to his life, but ... it costs the wild throat.

plays.desc_ko: SkewMond가 플래시로 진입했으나 피해를 거의 주지 못하고 도주 중 Berserker의 플래시 추격에 사망. Caps도 진입 타이밍을 노렸으나 Mel's(Mikael)에 막힘. Inspired는 '죽지 않는' 상태로 묘사.
plays.desc_en: SkewMond (Wukong) flashes in for little damage and dies to Berserker's Flash chase, while Caps' engage is stopped by Mikael's Blessing and Inspired seems unkillable.
plays.quote: SKAN TRYING TO MAKE DAMAGE. ... DOESN'T DO ANY DAMAGE. ... FLASH FORWARD FROM BERSERKER. DOWN HE

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 G2 기지로 진입해 넥서스 포탑 두 개를 파괴하고 넥서스를 노출시킴. Saint의 체력이 낮아 넥서스 마무리는 하지 않고 물러남.
plays.desc_en: LYON breaks into G2's base and destroys both Nexus towers, but backs off without finishing due to Saint's low health.
plays.quote: Saint may have gone too far. ... LION MOVING INTO THE BASE OF G2. ... Double towers

plays.desc_ko: 15초 뒤 등장하는 드래곤으로 LYON이 화염 드래곤 영혼(Infernal Soul) 획득.
plays.desc_en: LYON claims the Infernal Soul from the dragon spawning 15 seconds later.
plays.quote: the Infernal Soul coming up in 15 ... They have the infernal soul,

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 경기 마무리를 시도하는 중 해설이 Isles를 칭찬한 직후('캐스터 저주') LYON 선수 한 명이 쓰러짐. 이후 'Isles의 작은 실수'로 언급되어 Isles 사망으로 추정. 게임이 지연될 것이라고 해설.
plays.desc_en: As LYON tries to close, a LYON player falls right after casters praise Isles, likely Isles himself given a later 'small mistake' mention, delaying the game.
plays.quote: now Lion here trying to close the game. ... POTENTIAL CASTER CURSE. DOWN ... HE GOES.

plays.desc_ko: Berserker가 Caps를 처치. 해설은 이를 Isles의 실수를 만회하는 장면으로 평가하고, 원거리 위협이 사라졌다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: Berserker (Caitlyn) kills Caps (Syndra), making up for Isles' mistake and removing the long-range threat.
plays.quote: CAPS NOW BEING ALED. ... BERSERKER LEGENDARY. ... down. so much of the range threat.

plays.desc_ko: Caps 처치 후 LYON이 바텀에 자리 잡고 포탑을 노리는 듯했으나 무리하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: After killing Caps, LYON sets up bot as if for the tower but doesn't force it.
plays.quote: range engage now removed as Lion set up ... taking the tower. Not going to risk it

plays.desc_ko: G2가 BrokenBlade를 앞세워 진입. Hans Sama는 체력이 깎인 채 Berserker 사거리 밖에서 뒤로 빠지며 공격해야 하는 상황, Lulu 궁극기 사용.
plays.desc_en: G2 engages with BrokenBlade (Jayce) up front while a damaged Hans Sama (Yunara) must kite outside Berserker's range, and Lulu's ultimate is used.
plays.quote: All right, here comes G2 though. ... Blade on Broken Blade going in. ... ALULTI THERE

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 G2 후방으로 진입(Realm Warp 관련 언급)해 Wukong의 회전을 끊었으나 CC 연계를 이어가지 못하고, Bard 궁극기도 후퇴 중 빗나감. Inspired가 진정하고 물러나라고 한 것으로 보이며 LYON은 마무리하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Ryze) dives G2's backline, referencing Realm Warp, and interrupts Wukong's Cyclone but can't chain CC, and Isles' Tempered Fate misses; Inspired seemingly calls for calm and LYON doesn't finish.
plays.quote: BUT IT'S SAINT INTO THE ... SPINNING SHUT DOWN. ... DISASTER FROM SAINT

plays.desc_ko: Isles의 Tempered Fate가 다시 Labrov에게 적중했으나 후속 진입이 없음.
plays.desc_en: Isles' (Bard) Tempered Fate hits Labrov again but no one follows up.
plays.quote: connect collecting onto LRAV. No follow ... up there.

plays.desc_ko: Caps가 벽 너머로 포킹해 Isles 체력을 크게 깎아 LYON의 진입을 결정적으로 저지.
plays.desc_en: Caps (Syndra) pokes over a wall and chunks Isles (Bard), decisively stopping LYON's engage.
plays.quote: Cass poking over the wall ... chunking out Isles. Stops the engage ... from Lion critically.

plays.desc_ko: 장로 드래곤 40초 전 위쪽 강에서 SkewMond가 플래시로 진입했으나 Inspired가 후방에서 생존.
plays.desc_en: 40 seconds before Elder Dragon, SkewMond (Wukong) flashes in at top river, but Inspired survives in the back.
plays.quote: seconds on Elder playing towards the top ... Flash in from Schuman is fired ... still living in the back line.

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 G2 진형을 휩쓸고 빠져나오며 G2가 교전에서 무너짐. Berserker의 평타 화력, Saint의 Realm Warp로 BrokenBlade의 귀환로 차단. 탑 라인을 무너뜨리고 LYON이 경기를 끝내 G2를 탈락시킴.
plays.desc_en: Dhokla (Olaf) tears through G2 and escapes as G2 collapses, Berserker's (Caitlyn) auto attacks shred, and Saint's (Ryze) Realm Warp cuts off BrokenBlade's retreat; LYON breaks top and ends the game, eliminating G2.
plays.quote: RAMPAGING THROUGH AND GETTING RIGHT BACK ... G2 FALLING APART IN THE FIGHT. ... REALMORE FORWARD TO ENSURE
